name: Tree of Perdition
oracle_text:
Defender
{T}: Exchange target opponent's life total with this creature's toughness.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Exchange target opponent's life total with this creature's toughness.

needs.what: an op that exchanges a player's life total with a creature's toughness (701.12 / 701.12c): the player's life becomes the creature's toughness as a life gain or loss, and the creature's toughness becomes the player's former life total as an indefinite layer-7b characteristic-defining set; the exchange does nothing at all if either half cannot happen (the player can't gain/lose life, a locked life total, or the creature has left)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op sets or exchanges a life total. A hand-built chain of snapshot (life_of, toughness_of) + set_pt + a gain_life/lose_life of the difference would approximate it, but set_pt carries no indefinite-duration guarantee in op_options, and the chain cannot express the all-or-nothing rule: under cant_gain_life or lock_life_total the toughness would still change while the life does not. exchange_control exchanges controllers only.
